translation: The Lingshu jing says　uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu, 'when there is redness and pain in the middle of the eye beginning from the inner canthus, take the Yin Qiao.' (That is the Jiaoxin point.) It also says: With wind-cramp (fengjing) and the body folding backward, first take Foot Taiyang and the popliteal fossa (weizhong) and the blood-luo to let blood; if there is a cold pathogenic [influence] within, take the Yin Qiao and the three hairs above and the blood-luo to let blood. Li Binhu said: Foot Taiyang is the Jinggu point.
